description: Classic sleeveless tank top with continuous plain front and back bodice panels and contrasting patchwork trim bindings. Pattern geometry by FreeSewing 4.10.2 (MIT licence).

hybrid.name: Hybrid (Plain Body + Patchwork Binding)
hybrid.description: Front and back bodices cut from smooth solid fabric; armhole and neck bindings pieced from scrap strips.

patchwork.name: Full Patchwork
patchwork.description: Entire tank top (bodices and bindings) pieced together from fabric scraps.
patchwork.warning: Full patchwork requires piecing master sheets for body panels, creating many seams and taking substantial sewing time. Hybrid construction is recommended for comfort against skin.
